main_text.l: Trevisanus, Eques Auratus, Laurentius Amulius, & alij. Civium frequentia Venetijs plane
stupenda. Numerus trecentorum circiter millium censetur. Triplicis illi sunt
generis: Patritij, quos penes Imperij & Reip. administratio; Cives, qui Scribarum
& aliorum honorum munera gerunt; Artifices, qui mechanicas exercent Artes.
Præter hos, Mercatores ibi innumeri & advenæ, qui vario cultu ex omnibus mundi
partibus negociationis gratia confluere soliti: Turcæ, Æthiopes, Slavi, Arabes,
Syri, Cretenses, Cyprij, Macedones, Germani, Vngari, Hispani, Galli, alij. Familiæ

page.notes: Margin notes: left "Incolæ" beside the paragraph on civium frequentia; left "Familiæ nobiles" beside the closing sentence. Right-margin numerals 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are line counters, not text. Words in the list and the left-margin notes are partly doubtful; the printed page is faint and some letters, notably in the Greek-named and Venetian names, are uncertain. Mauroceni at the foot is a catchword-like addition.
